p-oliverspencer-15576437358975.d: In recent years, the humble polo shirt from tennis origins has undergone something of a makeover, repositioning itself as a much more elevated garment than mere sporting attire. p-oliverspencer-15576436801919.d: Based on the traditional western shirt with that iconic yoke shape and two chest flap pockets, the Witley jacket is a modern interpretation of classic Americana. p-oliverspencer-15576439849343.d: Part of an exclusive capsule for Liberty London, these Orsman trousers represent a thoroughly modern expression of style, cut with single-pleats and a wide-leg throughout to create a contemporary silhouette. p-oliverspencer-15443913736575.d: Riffing on the classic western jacket, our Buffalo jacket is cut from 100% organic cotton and features three front pockets and a turn-down collar. Unstructured for a natural drape, it's the perfect casual jacket for refined summer fits.

Unstructured for a natural drape, the jacket features a turn-down collar, double-ended zip closure and two chest pockets.
